The league played from 3 December 2000 until 27 May 2001.[https://www.vff.org.vn/uploads/docs/V-League2000-2001.pdf Giải VĐQG chuyên nghiệp thử nghiệm 2000/2001 (V-League lần 1) - VFF] == Foreign players == For the first time in history, foreign players were allowed to play in the V-League.
